text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The hot spring excavation is going 
smoothly. However, as for publicity..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—"Yukoma Onsen"~? Ah, is that what they 
were talking about at the recent school 
assembly?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I started going there too, and man, I 
totally recommend it~♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I've also got bargain info on nearby 
shops~ Honestly, it's the kind of stuff I 
wouldn't share for free, but I'll make a 
special exception this time...♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I want to relax, but I've got no time. 
Maybe when things settle down a bit? 
...Wait, I have a committee meeting! Catch 
ya later!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"A 'relaxing day' is pretty hard to come 
by unless you make a conscious effort to 
set one aside, isn't it...?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Publicity really is difficult, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, Tracen Academy students are way 
too busy to begin with!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Attending classes, doing homework, dance 
lessons, training, running races, fan 
service, and then, and then...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
There're sooo many academy events too! I 
can't miss out on the fun ones!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I hear all sorts of events were 
originally planned so students wouldn't 
end up buried only in studying and racing, 
you know?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oho~? But our academy is packed full of 
hard workers, so...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A school culture that values autonomy. 
High professionalism... I infer that it 
"expanded naturally in scale."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Then I suppose I need to be even 
more mindful about taking proper 'rests.'

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
And yet... you don't even have the leeway 
to come rest...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That's the real problem, isn't it? Even if 
we dig new springs or add more baths, it 
won't bring in more customers.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Because I understand all too well~~~~. 
That feeling of not even wanting to leave 
the house...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Still... just like Teio-chan was saying 
earlier...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You want to do fun things even if you have 
to push through exhaustion... That might 
just be the key!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(That's it...! If the charm can overcome 
the 'hassle'...)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Ahh, smells nice after all. The 
air is moist and soft, too. The city tends 
to get so dry...

text_block_list.name: Souvenir Shop Staff
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, closing time discounts! Hot 
spring carrots at half price~♪ Care for 
one, young lady?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Whoa, then I'll take one. Ehehe, lucky me!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Haaah... so warm...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I should've taken a picture before 
eating...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Nah... forget it for now.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... This sound is so nice too... It 
really feels like nature...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The sunset... is so pretty... With it 
being this red, tomorrow will probably be 
sunny too. ...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: It really is a lovely town...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you were here! Umm, I just couldn't 
sit still, so I came over.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
This hot spring resort... really does have 
a lot of wonderful things going for it.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I just know that if they come, they'll 
absolutely love it. So—!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: —So, it's for 'town revitalization'?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I used to be a local idol in 
Tomakomai, so I like to think I know a 
thing or two about it.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Could you at least let me try? I'll start 
by putting together a proposal...!"

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
My, are you sure? I don't mind at all, of 
course, but...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, there's no reason you can't. Go 
ahead and do as you like.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I look forward to 
working with you!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
What do you think! Check out this mascot 
character.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Is the name "Yukomaa"? "Yukcoma"...? Ah, 
"Yukomattari"...!?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how well done. It looks like medicinal 
bath water. That subtly quirky charm might 
just be a big hit.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The classic hot spring carrots... I wonder 
if we could add something extra to them?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
A new flavor, you say? Well now, if it 
needs to pair well with hot spring 
water...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"If we release an add-in recipe using the 
local specialties here, the synergy will 
make both of them go viral—!"

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Let's go~♪ Let's goooo~♪ To Yukoma 
Onseeeen~~~~♪ Ah, heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
………… "Hot spring cure, sightseeing, 
refreshing." "Yukoma Hot Spring Village".

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes, having it be slightly surreal is 
nice. I can clearly visualize the final 
edit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae tried various approaches. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whyyy!? We barely got any more 
customers~~!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I really thought it would work out. The 
pitch wasn't bad, right...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No, it's only natural that things aren't 
going well. Town revitalization is just 
that difficult.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Whether they'll find you or not is 
honestly down to luck. That's why you 
can't get discouraged, you just have to 
think of your next move. It's all about 
trial and error!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I see...! "Keep going until you can do 
it", huh. As expected of a "local idol", 
you really are something else.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Right, break's over! I'll head back to my 
room and cook up the next idea.
choice_data_list: (Is it really going to be all right...?)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hrrrmmm... it's no use... Nothing's coming 
to mind............

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
—Pardon me. Tarumae-sama, do you have a 
moment?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "Ah, yes! What can I do for you?"

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Good work. This is on the house. Please, 
help yourself.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"W-Wah, thank you so much...! It smells 
wonderful..."

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
This herbal tea helps you sleep 
peacefully. It'll warm you right up. Drink 
it slowly.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
A good night's sleep... Right, just 
because tomorrow is a day off doesn't mean 
I should stay up this late.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the enthusiasm, but you came 
here to rest, so take it easy.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I went and made you worry about 
me~~~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Or rather... have I just been slacking 
off at work without noticing? Staring at 
my notebook doing nothing...)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Nope, no good. You should know by now how 
important focus is.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Alright... that's it for today, bedtime!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day... During <chrname>'s training, we ran 
into our hot spring buddies.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —And that's what happened...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, well... That really is just so like 
Tarumae-chan.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I've learned my lesson. If I want to 
spread the joy of recuperation and hot 
springs, I need to embody it myself 
first!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, don't push yourself so hard. Take it 
easy, okay?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No, from now on, I've decided to try my 
best... to 'not try too hard'!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Um... somehow, without overworking 
ourselves, we'll work ha—, we'll 
revitalize the town!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... It's all right. Things will work 
out.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Even at times like this, I'm sure the hot 
springs will work their magic~♪
